value.rationale: Quantifies the first nontrivial coefficient-count threshold in greedy finite Fourier rearrangements, a motivated local invariant of the 2026 odd-cyclic rearrangement/divergence framework. It determines a universal 4/3 bound and exact smallest-prime arithmetic refinement on all odd finite abelian groups, with an explicit construction and complete equality rigidity. This is not merely the known two-character projection norm because it proves extremality under Fourier-magnitude ordering.
